description: This file defines a mobile tap and long-press handler for the Leaflet map library, enabling quick taps and long hold interactions on touch devices.

classes.name: Tap
classes.description: A handler class extending Leaflet's Handler to manage touch events for quick tap and long hold interactions.

methods.name: addHooks
methods.description: Attaches touchstart event listener to the map container.

methods.name: removeHooks
methods.description: Removes touchstart event listener from the map container.

methods.name: _onDown
methods.description: Handles touchstart event, initiates tap detection, highlights links, and sets timeout for long press.

methods.name: _onUp
methods.description: Handles touchend event, clears timeout, removes link highlight, and triggers click or context menu events.

methods.name: _isTapValid
methods.description: Checks if the touch movement is within the tap tolerance.

methods.name: _onMove
methods.description: Handles touchmove event, updates position, and simulates mousemove.

methods.name: _simulateEvent
methods.description: Creates and dispatches a simulated mouse event of specified type.
